task_desc: Test the story metadata completeness check mechanism. The guard hook must check the AC metadata in the story file (the Experiment, Type, Measured, Verify fields). If metadata is missing, it must not grant permission to write code.

Test the mandatory fields of the IR (Implementation Readiness) record. Before Sprint Planning, the IR record must contain all fields (goal, scope, constraints, dependencies). If a field is missing, Sprint Planning must not start.

QR (Quality Record) production experiment. When a story is completed, the QR record must contain status, evidence, and date for every DoD item. If a QR field is missing, the story must not be accepted as done.
Sprint planning flare experiment. Test whether stories are ordered correctly during sprint planning. No story with a dependency should precede blocked stories, and every story must have an epic.
Design a PRD validation experiment. Check a PRD file's methodology compliance: every requirement in the PRD must be linked to a story, and untested prototypes must be labeled as not tested.

Architecture spine generation experiment. Ask the LLM to generate an architecture spine for a project. The spine must contain the 5 invariant categories (paradigm, boundary, dependency, state, ownership).
